source.citation: FDA Center for Drug Evaluation and Research. VELCADE (bortezomib) NDA 021602, supplement S-027 (subcutaneous administration), review documents, 2011-2012. Clinical pharmacology (QT) review of sponsor study 26866138-CAN-1004.
source.storage: Downloaded by the platform owner; kept on her computer only (37 MB), not committed.
source.extraction: Table 7 (PDF page 293) and Table 2 (PDF page 286) are images. Read by OCR at 220 dpi and checked cell by cell against the rendered page image. Independent review pending.

relationship_to_model: Not used to build or fit the Lignet 2022 PK model (Hanley 2017 pediatric parameters scaled to adults). Not among the Ogawa 2008 patients. An external consistency check.

design.study: CAN-1004: randomized, open-label phase 1 study in relapsed multiple myeloma; 1.3 mg/m2 IV bolus or SC on days 1, 4, 8 and 11 of a 21-day cycle (FDA review, PDF page 228).
design.arm_used: IV bolus only (n = 10 PK-evaluable). The SC arm is not used: the model has no absorption step.
design.pk_sampling_quote: Table 2: +2, +5, +15, +30, +60, +120, +240, +360, +600 minutes; +24, +48, +72 hours, on Cycle 1 Day 1 and Day 11 (pre-dose sample at -30 minutes).
design.note_on_day1_72h: The day 1 72 h sample falls at the time of the day 4 dose; read as a pre-dose sample.

table7.location: Table 7, PDF page 293 (sponsor report CAN-1004 page 41)
not_reported: NCA software, AUC rule and terminal-phase points
